name: cocina-app
description: Costeo de recetas y registro de ventas para dark kitchen (Node + Angular + SQLite)

scripts.postinstall: npm --prefix backend install && npm --prefix frontend install
scripts.start: concurrently -k -n api,web -c cyan,magenta "npm --prefix backend start" "npm --prefix frontend start -- --open"
scripts.build: npm --prefix backend run build && npm --prefix frontend run build
